anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: our Passover sacrificed, Christ; feast with unleavened sincerity and truth.

pass_a_gloss: That even until today both the pascha happens and the sheep is sacrificed and the people come out from Egypt, the apostle also teaches us saying: For also our pascha was sacrificed, Christ, so that we may feast not with old leaven nor with leaven of malice and wickedness but with unleavened things of sincerity and truth.
pass_b_english: That even to this day the Passover still takes place, and the sheep is sacrificed, and the people come out from Egypt — the apostle also teaches us, saying: "For our Passover also has been sacrificed, Christ; so let us keep the feast not with old leaven nor with leaven of malice and wickedness, but with unleavened bread of sincerity and truth." (1 Corinthians 5:7–8)
source_text: [Ὅ]τι δὲ καὶ μέχρι σήμερον [κ]αὶ τὸ πάσχα γίνεται καὶ τ[ὸ] πρόβατον θύεται καὶ ὁ λαὸς [ἐξ] Αἰγύπτου ἐξέρχεται, κα[ὶ ὁ ἀ]πόστολος ἡμᾶς διδάσκε[ι λέ]γων· "Καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμ[ῶν] ἐτύθη Χ(ριστό)ς, ὥστε ἑορτάζω[με]ν μ[ὴ ζύ]μῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ζ[ύμῃ] κα[κί]ας καὶ πονηρία[ς ἀλλὰ ἀζύ]μοις εἱλικριν[είας καὶ ἀληθε]ίας".
